SELECT 
  MIN(lt.link) AS link_type, 
  MIN(t1.title) AS first_movie, 
  MIN(t2.title) AS second_movie
FROM 
  keyword k 
  INNER JOIN movie_keyword mk ON k.id = mk.keyword_id
  INNER JOIN title t1 ON mk.movie_id = t1.id
  INNER JOIN movie_link ml ON t1.id = ml.movie_id
  INNER JOIN link_type lt ON ml.link_type_id = lt.id
  INNER JOIN title t2 ON ml.linked_movie_id = t2.id
WHERE 
  k.keyword = '10,000-mile-club'
